stories.headline: Colombian police find 30 kilos of cocaine in checked luggage at Bogotá's El Dorado airport, bound for Punta Cana
stories.summary: Officers pulled a suitcase from an international flight shipment and found 30 rectangular packages of cocaine hydrochloride, which police value at over 259 million pesos.
